_comment: Tunable parameters for the AI anomaly detection engine. Edit these without touching Python code.

clamp._comment: The AI fetches the MINIMUM of (events from the last max_days days) and (last max_requests_per_user events per user). This prevents stale data from polluting sequences while keeping sufficient history for statistical analysis.

lstm._comment: Core LSTM hyperparameters. The role-conditioned model uses embedding_dim for both action and role embeddings. Weight is now in signal_weights.

statistical_profiler._comment: z_score_threshold: how many standard deviations above the user's mean transfer amount triggers a flag. min_history_for_stats: minimum number of transactions before the profiler activates (avoids false positives on new users). frequency_window_minutes: time window for burst detection. Weight is now in signal_weights.

temporal_analyzer._comment: Business hours in local time (24h format). after_hours_ratio_threshold: fraction of recent actions outside business hours to start scoring. diversity_spike_multiplier: how many times higher recent action diversity must be vs historical to flag.

signal_weights._comment: Weights for the 4-signal fusion engine. Must sum to 1.0. If any single signal exceeds single_signal_escalation_threshold, the fused score is floored at 0.7 (MEDIUM).

alerting._comment: Fused risk score ranges: [0, low) = NORMAL, [low, medium) = LOW severity, [medium, high) = MEDIUM severity, [high, 1.0] = HIGH severity.

training._comment: threshold_percentile: the percentile of training MSE reconstruction errors used to set the dynamic anomaly threshold. 0.90 means 10% of normal traffic will be borderline.
